verdict.rationale: Gmail's API is thoroughly documented for programmatic reading, sending, drafting-equivalent (via send/MIME), filtering/labeling, and push notifications on mailbox changes, which gives external agents a documented path to read/triage/send email end-to-end (gmail-docs-1,20,25,26,15,18,21,27). However, there is no evidence of a native or first-party connector for Claude/ChatGPT specifically, no MCP server, and probes for machine-readable agent interfaces (llms.txt, OpenAPI) return 404, meaning any AI agent integration must be custom-built on top of the API rather than a turnkey documented agent connection. Missing for 10: an official Claude/ChatGPT/MCP integration or agent-specific documentation, and any evidence of drafting (not just sending) via the API.
